    Frequently Asked Questions

    You’ll need to bring your Aadhar card as address proof, along with a photo, when selling gold.

    You can sell gold for cash using only two documents: a passport photo and an Aadhar card.

    Our branches welcome you from Monday to Saturday, operating from 10 am to 7 pm. Check out our website to find the nearest White Gold location.

    Yes, you can sell gold without a hallmark; however, the payment you receive will be determined by the gold’s purity value.

    No, we do not buy diamonds and silver. We only operate our business as GOLD Buyer.

    Unlike many other types of investments, gold is relatively easy to convert into cash. There is consistently a strong demand for gold, whether it’s in the form of coins, bars, or other formats. Typically, the gold items sold are melted down and refined into pure gold.
